'''Giovanni Paolo Galdi''' (born January 3, 1947) is an [[Italy|Italian]] [[mathematician]], who works primarily on the mathematical analysis of the [[Navier–Stokes equations|Navier-Stokes equations]]; in particular, on the topics of fluid-structure interactions and hydrodynamic stability. He is a Distinguished Professor of Mechanical Engineering and Materials Science, the Leighton E. and Mary N. Orr Professor of Engineering, and Professor of Mathematics at the [[University of Pittsburgh]], as well as adjunct professor at the [[Tata Institute of Fundamental Research]] in [[Mumbai]]. He serves on the editorial board of the journal ''Nonlinear Analysis'' and is co-founder and editor-in-chief of the ''[[Journal of Mathematical Fluid Mechanics]]'' as well as the book series ''Advances in Mathematical Fluid Mechanics'' and ''Lecture Notes in Mathematical Fluid Mechanics''.<ref name="GaldiHome"/><ref>{{Cite web |title=Journal of Mathematical Fluid Mechanics |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/21 |access-date=2025-04-17 |website=SpringerLink |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite book |url=https://link.springer.com/10.1007/978-3-642-04068-9 |title=Advances in Mathematical Fluid Mechanics: Dedicated to Giovanni Paolo Galdi on the Occasion of his 60th Birthday |date=2010 |publisher=Springer Berlin Heidelberg |isbn=978-3-642-04067-2 |editor-last=Rannacher |editor-first=Rolf |location=Berlin, Heidelberg |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-3-642-04068-9 |editor-last2=Sequeira |editor-first2=Adélia}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Lecture Notes in Mathematical Fluid Mechanics |url=https://www.springer.com/series/15480?srsltid=AfmBOorLGTK1NtCCr6rvTmEwCZMU19AzQvHvkaO_bAI_smJWd8lVxjm8 |access-date=2025-04-17 |website=Springer |language=en}}</ref>

==Education and career==
Galdi earned his doctorate in Physics from the [[University of Naples Federico II|University of Naples]] in 1971.<ref name="GaldiHome">{{cite web | url=https://www.engineering.pitt.edu/people/faculty/g.-paolo-galdi | title=University of Pittsburgh Swanson School of Engineering G. Paolo Galdi }}</ref> He would later serve as professor there, in the Department of Mathematics, after completing his post-doctoral mathematical training in 1976, under the mentorship of [[Salvatore Rionero]] and [[James Serrin]].<ref name="BirkhauserBook">{{cite book | url=https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/978-3-642-04068-9.pdf | doi=10.1007/978-3-642-04068-9 | title=Advances in Mathematical Fluid Mechanics | date=2010 | isbn=978-3-642-04067-2 | editor-last1=Rannacher | editor-last2=Sequeira | editor-first1=Rolf | editor-first2=Adélia }}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=69135&fChrono=1 | title=Giovanni Galdi - the Mathematics Genealogy Project }}</ref> In 1985, he joined the [[University of Ferrara]], where he founded the School of Engineering, serving as engineering Dean from 1989 to 1995.<ref name=":0" /> Since 1999, he has been a professor at the [[University of Pittsburgh]], first in the Department of Mathematics, and then later in the [[Swanson School of Engineering]], where he currently holds his tenure.<ref name="GaldiHome"/>

==Mathematical contributions==
Galdi works in mathematical [[fluid dynamics|hydrodynamics]], having written on the [[Navier-Stokes Equations]] and [[magnetohydrodynamics]].<ref name="GaldiHome"/> Among his purely mathematical contributions is a generalized theory of homogeneous [[Sobolev space|Sobolev spaces]] for [[Domain (mathematical analysis)|unbounded domains]], which has become a cornerstone in the study of [[external flow|external flows]].<ref name="Gadi_SteadyState">{{cite book | url=https://doi.org/10.1007/978-0-387-09620-9 | doi=10.1007/978-0-387-09620-9 | title=An Introduction to the Mathematical Theory of the Navier-Stokes Equations | series=Springer Monographs in Mathematics | date=2011 | isbn=978-0-387-09619-3 }}</ref> He has also done foundational work in the mathematical theory of [[fluid-structure interaction|fluid-structure interactions]],<ref name="Galdi_FluidSturct">{{cite book | url=https://doi.org/10.1016/S1874-5792(02)80014-3 | doi=10.1016/S1874-5792(02)80014-3 | title=On the Motion of a Rigid Body in a Viscous Liquid: A Mathematical Analysis with Applications | series=Handbook of Mathematical Fluid Dynamics | date=2002 | last1=Galdi | first1=Giovanni P. | volume=1 | pages=653–791 | isbn=978-0-444-50330-5 }}</ref> a field of research in which he is still currently active. His book, ''An Introduction to the Mathematical Theory of the Navier-Stokes Equations: Steady-State Problems'' (1994)<ref name="Gadi_SteadyState"/> and article ''On the Motion of a Rigid Body in a Viscous Liquid: A Mathematical Analysis with Applications'' (2002)<ref name="Galdi_FluidSturct"/> are widely used.

In 2010, a dedicated [[Springer Science+Business Media|Springer]] volume was published in honor of his 60th birthday.<ref name=":0" />
